conversion.fractional_rule: Integer shares; remaining units allocated by descending fractional remainder across holders; equal remainders exceeding available units resolved randomly. Individual account rounding is not inferable from quantity alone.

reference_prices.meaning: Ratio calculation references, not cash proceeds or execution prices.

accounting_limits: No economic zero merely because old shares disappear from account display between termination and new share listing.
No price concatenation of old and successor codes without quantity/rights and price policies.
Cash election branch, actual elections, unclaimed dividends, pledges, freezes, fees and account-specific fractional allocation are not reconstructed here.
General listing date does not prove a particular account could sell all shares at a particular price.
unqualified: Old Sina adjusted-price snapshot and anchor
Realized terminal cash or total-return label
2024 earlier suspension cause; current unit covers 2025 terminal suspension only
implementation_status: Factual sidecar, not wired into research engine or production; no parser flag authorizes a merge event automatically.
